scripts.dev: npm run build -w @exchange/protocol && concurrently -k "npm run dev -w @exchange/api" "npm run dev -w @exchange/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @exchange/protocol && npm run build -w @exchange/api && npm run build -w @exchange/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @exchange/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test -w @exchange/protocol && npm run test -w @exchange/api
scripts.test:full: npm test && npm run build -w @exchange/api && node scripts/security-integration.mjs --full
